items.headline: Anthropic files public S-1 with the SEC, plans Nasdaq listing under ticker ANT
items.summary: The filing reveals an $80.7B net loss in the first half of 2026 alongside 1,368% year-over-year revenue growth. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley will lead the offering, expected in mid-November. Anthropic warns that advanced AI could pose catastrophic or existential risks.
items.why: Anthropic becomes the first frontier AI lab to file a public S-1. The disclosure gives investors and the public their first audited look at the economics of building frontier AI, including nearly $400B in committed cloud spending across Amazon, SpaceX, Google and Microsoft.

items.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra for computer use at $1 per million input tokens
items.summary: Terra replaces GPT-5.6 Terra as OpenAI's budget computer-use model. It reads screens and acts by clicking and typing across apps. OpenAI says it matched GPT-6 Astra results at a tenth of the price. Available in ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Enterprise, Edu and Codex.

items.headline: OpenAI claims its models proved the local smoothing conjecture and disproved the Exponential Time Hypothesis
items.summary: Three preprints dated October 25 claim AI-produced results on the Kakeya conjecture, the Exponential Time Hypothesis and Yang-Mills existence. All have been formalized in Lean. OpenAI formed independent expert panels to verify and says the results are unconfirmed.
